name: CardzCon Trade Night Riyadh
blurb: Riyadh trading-card trade night from the CardzCon brand, held as a preview ahead of its main Doha convention.

last.venue: Radisson Blu Hotel, Riyadh Convention & Exhibition Center

notes: Found while researching the Gulf fixup list (not previously in series.json/pipeline/research). The official Riyadh page says the event 'has concluded' and 'CardzCon is heading to Doha next' (see cardzcon-doha), with no next Riyadh date announced, so this may have been a one-off preview rather than an annual Riyadh fixture; recorded separately from cardzcon-doha per the multi-city rule.
